description: This file is a script for generating a TypeScript module containing environment variable candidates for bundled providers, based on plugin source data. It includes functions for normalizing provider environment variables, collecting plugin sources, rendering output, and writing the output file.

methods.name: normalizeProviderAuthEnvVars
methods.description: Normalizes provider authentication environment variables into a sorted array of [providerId, envVars] pairs, filtering out invalid entries.

methods.name: collectBundledProviderAuthEnvVars
methods.description: Collects and aggregates provider auth environment variables from plugin sources, returning a sorted object.

methods.name: renderBundledProviderAuthEnvVarModule
methods.description: Generates TypeScript code defining a constant object with provider IDs and their environment variables, formatted for consumption.

methods.name: writeBundledProviderAuthEnvVarModule
methods.description: Coordinates collecting, rendering, and writing the generated module file.
